invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, so the result should not be null upon method exit.
The compactionInstantTime parameter is likely a non-null String representing time, so it should be non-null.
The metadata inside the HoodieWriteMetadata result should be non-null to represent write statuses.
The list of WriteStatus in the result's metadata should have a non-negative size (possibly empty).
The context parameter is an input context object and should be non-null.
